headline: Ukraine Feeds 3 Million Students With Free Hot Meals
meta_description: Ukraine expands free hot meal programme to 3 million children in grades 1–11 at public schools, including students in frontline regions.
summary_short: Ukraine has rolled out free hot meals to 3 million schoolchildren nationwide, extending the programme even to students in frontline areas facing Russian attacks.
body:
Ukraine now provides free hot school meals to 3 million children nationwide, with the programme reaching every student in grades 1 to 11 at public schools. The expansion demonstrates commitment to student welfare despite ongoing conflict.

Remarkably, the initiative extends even to frontline regions facing Russian attacks, ensuring that children across the country—regardless of their proximity to combat zones—have access to nutritious meals during the school day. This universal approach reflects a deliberate choice to prioritize children's health and education across all of Ukraine's territory.

The programme represents both a practical support system for families and a statement of continuity: education and child welfare continue, even as communities endure extraordinary hardship.
quick_facts: 3 million Ukrainian children now receive free hot meals daily
Programme covers all students in grades 1 through 11
Available at all public schools nationwide
Extended to frontline regions under Russian attack
